name: fde-tutor-platform
description: Private Phase 0/1 build workspace for the S083 FDE Tutor platform spine.

scripts.build: npm run contracts:validate && npm run identity:validate && npm run openapi:validate && npm run scope:validate && npm run build --workspace @fde-tutor/learner-web && dotnet build FdeTutor.sln
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @fde-tutor/learner-web && dotnet format FdeTutor.sln --verify-no-changes --no-restore
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run identity:validate && npm run openapi:validate && npm run scope:validate && npm run test --workspace @fde-tutor/learner-web && dotnet test FdeTutor.sln
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
